Wheel configuration comparison

Each section is one commanded direction; each panel is one wheel configuration, and every panel in a row shares the same axes. Faint lines are individual trials, the bold line is their mean and the dashed line is what was commanded. Panel titles give the matching error, mean ± σ across trials: final position error for position, final heading error for heading, and speed RMS error (actual vs commanded speed over the run) for speed. Hover a line to see which trial it is.

Jump to: 0° · 45° · 90° · 135° · 180° · 225° · 270° · 315°

Plots use the robot's starting frame: the start position is the origin and the starting heading points up (0°), so the expected path runs at the commanded angle. Heading is the change from the starting heading.
